_about: Starting Forest (the Opening Forest, docs/art/opening_forest.md). Deep teal-blue dusk/night after the paint-over (OF-01): a dim cool moon key, teal ambient and fog, the camp lantern's amber pool and glowing mushrooms do the warm and cool accents.
